body:
BUG-2398 independent advisor verdict: CHANGES REQUESTED. The full text is posted as a comment on BUG-2398.

The direction is accepted: advisor14's A1-A6 plus the root amendment. No global policy change, IDs treated as selectors, the ADR-66 same-uid replay residual recorded truthfully, and mail wake (codex queue) inherits the launch argv.

Blocking:
- B1. On every path, argv is fixed BEFORE the child grant is issued: agent_launch ~6711 vs ~6807, run_vendor_headless_child customize, the reviewer plan, the exec_codex_session native arm. The override helper must run once at the final pre-spawn point and read only explicit Command envs, never std::env. It inserts the -c pairs right after the codex token, including inside the bwrap wrapper. A non-baseline seat with no explicit grant refuses. Add a ratchet covering every Codex constructor.
- B2. Whitelist AIDA_ROLE_INSTANCE. If it is absent, current_role_instance_is_companion() returns false, so a companion would get driver semantics with a real grant. That would be a new widening.
- B3. Name AIDA_HANDLE_LAUNCH_TOKEN and AIDA_AGENT_REGISTRY_TOKEN as denied, and document that the tool shell cannot bind its handle.
- B4. The real codex sandbox fixture must prove that set.AIDA_SESSION_GRANT="" arrives present-empty, or the docs must record what Codex actually does, with no fallback.

Once root records adoption of B1-B4 on the spec, this verdict becomes APPROVED with no further advisor round.
subject: BUG-2398 advisor gate: CHANGES REQUESTED (B1-B4, pre-cleared on adoption)
